title: Tangent projections of an embedded C¹ submanifold have rank m and vary continuously along M (parent steps 0.1, 0.3)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let M ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M). For x ∈ ℝ^P write S_x := span_ℝ(tangentSpace M x) and P_x := S_x.starProjection, the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto S_x viewed as a continuous linear map ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Then (a) dim S_x = m for every x ∈ M; (b) x ↦ P_x is continuous on M (relative topology on M, operator norm on L(ℝ^P)); (c) for every C¹ map X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P the function x ↦ trace(P_x ∘ DX(x)) (DX(x) = fderiv ℝ X x) is continuous on M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)) = m) ∧ ContinuousOn (fun x => (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection) M ∧ ∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → ContinuousOn (fun x => LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap)) M
